frames.gloss: 强调句：正是 [A] 做了/是 [B]（把焦点成分提到 It is...who/that 之间）
frames.pattern_notes: 固定虚词骨架 it is/was ... who/that ...，槽位 A 为被强调成分（主语/宾语/状语），B 用陈述语序。学习者极易把 it 当形式主语或把 who/that 读成定语从句关系词，属典型误读点。去掉 It is/was...who/that 后句子仍完整，可作识别检验。

examples.s: It’s my father who likes to eat fast food in front of the TV,” he laughs.
Although the majority of the current population is of European descent, it was the ethnic minority group known as the Maori who were the first to settle there.

frames.frame: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词 [A]
frames.gloss: 最……的……之一（A 为范围/补充说明）
frames.pattern_notes: 固定骨架 one of the + 形容词最高级 + 复数名词，名词必须复数、最高级前 the 不可省，是中文无对应的高频整存整取块。常见误读：漏 the、名词用单数、或把 one of 理解成“其中一个”后接不动最高级。可后接地点范围或定语从句作 A 槽。

examples.s: "Garth is one of the most successful musicians in American history.
Probably one of the most beneficial innovations is drip irrigation, which has made it possible to develop big, green farms in the middle of the desert.
Blank verse is probably one of the most common and influential forms of English.
Christiane Heinicke, one of the people who lived there, said that one of the biggest issues was feeling bored.

frames.frame: as + 形容词/副词 + as possible / as [sb] can
frames.pattern_notes: 固定骨架 as...as possible 或 as...as sb can/could，中间槽位放形容词/副词原级（可带宾语如 as many things as...）。与清单中已有 as...as（两者比较）不同，这里 as 后接的是能力极限标记 possible/can，语义是“尽最大可能”，应作独立框架收录。

examples.s: The dog will try making itself look as big as possible.
They often do not follow strict grammar rules, because writers use as few words as possible to catch the attention of the readers.
Note down as many things as you can recall, and then retell the story using your notes.

frames.gloss: 这样（一来），……（承前做法，引出结果/目的）
frames.pattern_notes: 句首话语框架：This/That way 回指上文的办法，逗号后主句给出结果，常用将来时或 be able to。this way 在口语中还有“这边走”义，句首承前用法易被误读为指路。

examples.s: That way, you will know what you are supposed to do in diﬀ erent situations.
This way, you will be able to fix the problem before your home becomes flooded or catches fire.

candidates.note: make it possible (for sb) to do：2 例重复（J04565、S03876），搭配极固定，但属 it 作形式宾语的不定式外置构式，判据1（纯语法范畴不报）拿不准，记候选。

example.s: You helped to make it possible for me to have Lucky.

candidates.note: Up to now / Until now, + 现在完成时（S08522、S05850 两例）：时间状语与时体绑定，骨架感弱、更像时体规则，拿不准判据1。

example.s: ” Up to now, nobody has been able to create laughter like Charlie Chaplin.

candidates.note: the + 最高级 + 名词 + in the world（J05457、J05460 两例）：整存整取有用，但本质是最高级语法范畴，拿不准判据1/2。

example.s: And the Amazon is the second longest river in the world.

candidates.note: as soon as 引导时间从句：语篇自然、有骨架，但本批仅 1 例（J04893），不够重复判据。

example.s: And as soon as the TV program came out more than 30 years ago, Western children became interested in reading this story because the clever Monkey King keeps fighting to help the weak and never gives up.

candidates.note: go on to do（接着做另一件事）：叙事推进框架，本批仅 1 例。

example.s: ” Later, she went on to study medicine as she had wished.

candidates.note: This is because + 从句：可视为已收录 This/That is why 的 because 变体，本批仅 1 例。

example.s: This is because people believe in the importance of carrying on space exploration despite the huge risks.

candidates.note: more [A] than expected：比较结构+省略，仅 1 例，与已收 more A than anyone thought 同族。

example.s: Scientists have collected more data than expected to prove the theory.

candidates.note: 成对状语 day and night, rain or shine（并列名词作状语表持续）：仅 1 例，结构有趣但无重复。

example.s: For more than two years, Michelangelo worked on David day and night, rain and shine, until it was completed.

candidates.note: the number of [A] + 单数谓语（区别于 a number of）：仅 1 例。

example.s: The number of people who were killed or badly injured in the quake was more than 400,000.

candidates.note: not ... anymore（J05239）：口语高频，仅 1 例且句子残缺（OCR 断句）。

example.s: Amy can give away the and because they do not fit her anymore.
